body:
Thursday: the trial crew left their work shirts in the spare room. The sharp smell reached the kitchen, and the dog was sick before the road patrol arrived.

They counted the containers before anyone counted who had carried them. I wrote the second number here while I could still remember it.

There may be a simple reason for the change. Nobody at the next stop could tell us what to do with the first version.
title: The room nobody wanted

body:
They gave us a count for the beds and told us it was final. Then another family arrived at the back door with a child too tired to stand.

We made room and I put her shoes under the bed so nobody would trip. In the morning the list still had the old count. A visitor looked at the shoes and asked us to move them before the next inspection.

The child did not understand why her mother kept calling her by a different name. I did, but I did not tell her.
title: The extra occupant
